author: Sergio Speziale
confirmed_prescription: Numerically integrate d ln(theta) = -gamma(V) d ln(V), using the variable-q gamma law in Speziale (2001) Equation 11.
scope: Confirms the gamma law and Debye-temperature integration prescription from the author's recollection. Does not recover the original calculator, integration grid, fit objective, weights, covariance, shock reduction or later Fei/Hirose reducers.
reply_verbatim:
Dear Clemens,

your project is a very good idea.

As for my old article:

The formula I eventually used to express the volume dependence of the Grüneisen parameter was the one with variable q (inspired by some previous work by Raymond Jeanloz).

I can confirm that I numerically integrated your equation N5 by using S11, using the equation numbering of your notes.

I generally used a simple trapezoidal integration approach.

I cannot currently fetch the original calculator. But I am pretty sure about this integration approach.

Ciao!

Sergio
